errors.text: The hypothesis addresses largely quasi-static tensile properties rather than dynamic strength–ductility performance under defined strain rates.
It does not reconstruct the target intervention of orientation-, temperature-, and strain-rate-controlled tensile loading of single-crystal equiatomic FeNiCrMn.
The proposed experiment lacks specified alloy composition, loading rate, matched processing controls, microstructural measurements, and a quantitative falsification criterion.
Results demonstrated for a tungsten refractory high-entropy alloy are generalized to high-entropy alloys as a class without defining the applicable compositional or microstructural domain.
